items.title: 4.9.1 Tibb (medicine) mein stoichiometry ki ahmiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.9.1, printed page 91.

blocks.text: Stoichiometry tibb (medicine) ke maidan mein bohat aham hai aur in tareeqon se istemal hoti hai.

items: Antibiotics ki tayyari mein stoichiometry yaqeeni banati hai ke har khuraak active ingredient aur target bacteria se mutabiq ho.
Mareezon ke khoon mein cholesterol ki satah maloom karne ke liye; cholesterol charbi ki ek shakal hai jo sari buri nahi, magar nuqsan-deh asar rakh sakti hai.
Ziabetes ke mareez ke khoon mein glucose ki satah maloom karne ke liye; insulin ka istemal khoon ki shakar par theek qaboo ke liye stoichiometry par munhasir hai.
Khilarion ke peshab mein steroids aur doosre muharrikat (stimulants) maloom karne ke liye, jo woh karkardagi barhane aur taqat barhane ke liye lete hain.
Vaccine ki tayyari mein viral antigens ki concentration maloom karne ke liye, moassar nataij ke liye.

Mareez ki khuraak ke liye dawaon ki miqdar aur tadaad maloom karne ke liye: dawa kam miqdar mein be-asar hoti hai aur zyada miqdar mein zehreeli halat ya maut ka sabab ban sakti hai. Paracetamol dard-kush aur bukhar kam karne ke liye istemal hoti hai; overdose khoon patla karne, aaza ke nuqsan aur jigar ke shadeed nuqsan ka sabab ban sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Paracetamol ki durust khuraak kyun aham hai, aur pharmacist use nikalte waqt stoichiometry ka kaun sa khayal istemal karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Bohat kam paracetamol be-asar hai, jabke overdose khoon patla kar sakta aur aaza, khas kar jigar, ko nuqsan pohncha sakta hai. Pharmacist mass, molar mass aur moles ke taalluq, aur active ingredient ki concentration, se mareez ke jism ke liye theek irada-shuda dawa ki miqdar deta hai.

items: Stoichiometry antibiotic khuraakein tai karti hai, khoon ka cholesterol aur glucose napti hai (insulin qaboo), khilarion mein steroids pakarti hai, vaccines mein viral antigen concentrations tai karti hai, aur mehfooz dawa ki khuraakein nikalti hai (paracetamol overdose jigar ko nuqsan deta hai).
